Payments processing market outlook 2025-2030

Card acceptance kept widening last year. The global payments processing market is projected to grow at a compound annual rate of 9.8% from 2025 to 2030. Growth is strongest among small merchants.

The outlook assumes steady consumer spending and continued migration from cash to cards and digital wallets. Cross-border volumes are the most volatile part of the forecast.

This fictional report was prepared for a software demonstration.
